blocks.tamil_translation: “The Prophet ﷺ asked the Sahabah (RA), “Do you know who the one who has lost everything (the muflis) is?” The Sahabah (RA) said, “Among us, the one who has no dirham (money) and no worldly goods is the (muflis).” “In my Ummah, the muflis, the one who has lost everything, is the one who will come on the Day of Qiyamah with good deeds such as abundant Salah, fasting and Zakat (and other accepted acts of worship), but he will have abused someone, slandered someone, consumed someone's wealth, killed someone, and beaten someone; so good deeds will be taken from his good deeds and given to the one who has the right (to the extent of the injustice he did). In the same way, good deeds will be taken from his good deeds and given to the other rightful claimants as well (to the extent of their right from the injustice he did). If all his good deeds run out before the rights owed to others are settled, the sins (of injustice) of the rightful claimants will be taken from them (to the extent of the injustice he did) and placed upon him. And then he will be thrown into Jahannam. This is the (muflis), the one who has lost everything,” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: سِبَابُ الْمُسْلِمِ فُسُوْقٌ، وَقِتَالُهُ كُفْرٌ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري، باب ما ينهي من السباب واللعن، رقم:٦٠٤٤
blocks.tamil_translation: “Abusing a Muslim is an act outside the Din (fusuq), and killing him is disbelief — kufr.” Hazrat Abdullah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said this.

blocks.text: Explanation:- The Muslim who kills another
